request.questionText: Which of the following statements is accurate with respect to the normal distribution? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Normal distributions are unimodal and symmetric.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The probability is about 95% that a normal random variable X will take on a value within two standard deviations of its expected value (mean).

choices.label: C
choices.text: The normal distribution is characterized with two parameters: the mean and the standard deviation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The normal distribution is characterized with two parameters: the median and the IQR.

choices.label: E
choices.text: The normal distribution is also known informally as a "bell curve" and more formally as a Gaussian distribution.
